Print technologist/login 100%, on site | Manufacture Horlogère Suisse | ETA SA
• Printing technologist/login 100%, on site
• Your future areas of responsibility Contact person for production in the area of digital printing
• Project support for the introduction of new digital printing machines
• Commissioning of machines and software as well as support of the introduction into production
• Creation of user documentation, such as maintenance plans, operating instructions and training documents
• Conducting training for employees in the area of digital printing
• Responsibility for continuous improvements and coordination of the corresponding measures
• Preparation and configuration of the RIP software for production operations
• Supporting the development department with new developments
• Main contact for color management
• Your skills and competenciesCompleted professional training as a printing technologist/login EFZ or media technologist/login EFZ
• Sound experience in digital printing or 4-color printing
• Strong technical understanding and high quality awareness
• Very good PC knowledge, especially in dealing with RIP software
• Good color vision and in-depth knowledge of color management (CMS)
• It awaits you a varied and demanding job in day-to-day operations that requires a high degree of independence and personal responsibility
• Apply
• LanguagesYou have fluent German skills, English and/or French is an advantage
• This is what awaits you with usAn exciting working environment in a company that is constantly developing and offers numerous advantages:
• Diverse opportunities for further training
• Internal mobility with attractive career prospects
• Five or six weeks of vacation per year (depending on age and/or function)
• 40-hour week in accordance with the GAV
• Attractive wage policy and good social benefits
• Three weeks of parental leave for fathers and up to 19 weeks for mothers
• Company restaurant
• Discounts on products from the Swatch Group and other partner companies
• Sports activities and company events
• Participation in health insurance
• Where you can find usETA SA Manufacture Horlogère Suisse
• 2540 Grenchen
• Good accessibility by public transport

• Please apply exclusively online via our website – for the sake of the environment and to ensure efficient processing.
